settings.inputMeasure: caller-derived tr_daily row count within one already-established participant ID group
settings.inputBoundary: One caller-supplied nonnegative integer count of rows in the already-constructed tr_daily table for one participant ID. Chronicle does not reconstruct tr_daily or group and count its rows in this binding.
settings.outputBoundary: Report only whether the supplied grouped row count is at least 8. Equality at 8 satisfies the source predicate; the later intersection with the installed-ID list is not performed.
limitations: The binding does not construct, deduplicate, order, or impute tr_daily rows and does not define a row as a completed tracking day.
The binding does not group tr_daily by ID or derive the per-ID n() value; the caller owns both operations.
The binding does not create the installed-ID list from T0 and tr_daily or apply the subsequent inner_join with that list.
A passing threshold is not final participant inclusion, eligibility, or cohort membership.
